The '''Naos Asteroid Belt'''<ref name="Legacy of Dathka Graush" /> was situated in the [[Naos system/Legends|Naos system]], in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="TEA" /> At some point, a [[Dathka Graush's fortress|fortress]] in the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] was inhabited by [[Dathka Graush/Legends|Dathka Graush]],<ref name="Legacy of Dathka Graush" /> a [[Sith King]]<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> who ruled on<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031002korriban|text=Korriban: Planet of Lost Souls|int=Korriban: Planet of Lost Souls}}</ref> the distant<ref name="TEA" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] around [[7000 BBY]].<ref name="Wizards" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Legacy of Dathka Graush" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the game, the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> an individual affiliated with one of the sides in the then-ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sought and found the [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] in the Naos Asteroid Belt.<ref name="Legacy of Dathka Graush" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Naos Asteroid Belt was introduced in an Archaeology Crew Skill mission of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]], though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Legacy of Dathka Graush" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Naos [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the asteroid belt, in grid square S-18.<ref name="TEA" />
